title: PAR-134 MTEXT background-scale finite preflight
mode: focused AC1024/AC1032 local writer/parser fast slice; scratch peer-producer trace
scope: Reject non-finite MTEXT background scale before the standalone MTEXT DWG common prefix is written
Share finite-scale validation with embedded MTEXT DWG output
Investigate the ODA BL versus BD field-width discrepancy without changing its unresolved width

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The MTEXT background-scale row labels the field BL while giving a default of 1.5, which cannot be represented by an integer bit-long. No production width change is justified from this internally conflicting row alone.

localPeerProducer.finding: A locally authored scratch MText with background fill and integer scale 2 was emitted by LibreDWG; its writer trace labels the field bg_fill_scale: 2 [BL 45]. LibreDWG's own read-to-DXF output retains group 45 as 2.0. This proves the LibreDWG 0.14.0 route uses BL, not that all producers do.

conflictingPeerEvidence.finding: ODA and LibreDWG's current published structure describe BL, while ACadSharp's source uses WriteBitDouble for this field despite its BL comment; a separately published Rust binding also reports BD. The peer implementations therefore disagree, and no AutoCAD/ODA-authored non-integral MTEXT background-scale sample is available in the checked-in corpus.

localReaderLimitation.finding: The libdxfrw converter rejected the LibreDWG-produced AC1018 scratch file at BAD_READ_FILE_HEADER (legacy error 5), before object/entity parsing; it does not provide a libdxfrw parser trace for this MTEXT field. No sample file was copied into the repository.

localSource.finding: The shared standalone/embedded CMC preparation path now rejects a non-finite background scale. Standalone rejection occurs before the common MTEXT prefix; the embedded path shares the same validation.

generatedControls.finding: A generated AC1032 NaN background-scale control verifies refusal with body, detached string, and handle buffers all untouched. Existing finite-scale background CMC vectors continue to exercise the production parser/writer round trip.
generatedControls.limit: Generated controls establish local codec behavior only; the LibreDWG scratch output is a peer-specific locally created sample, not native AutoCAD/ODA evidence.

productionSummary: Pass background scale through shared CMC preflight and reject non-finite values before standalone output.
Apply the same finite check to the embedded MTEXT writer without changing its field width.
Retain BD output pending authoritative producer evidence that resolves the ODA row/default contradiction.

unresolved: Resolve BL versus BD using an AutoCAD/ODA-authored sample with non-integral background scale or another authoritative producer trace before changing the field width.
The locally generated LibreDWG AC1018 file fails libdxfrw at file-header parsing, so it cannot qualify libdxfrw's entity-level read path.
Standalone MTEXT source-method identity, HATCH C5 producer semantics, class-specific DXF mappings, and external/native qualification remain open.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
